title: ArUco Studio: the functionality we want, and the tests
about: Two separate lists, as Zach asked: 'features' is the functionality we want; 'tests' is how we check it.
Every feature and test starts as 'planned'. A builder sets a feature to 'built' and a test to 'passing' / 'failing' with the command that shows it.
'ref_ids' and 'ref_tests' point at REF's docs/aruco_spec.json (cad-exporter, c8216ff) so nothing is lost in the move. REF test ids are quoted verbatim (EX-MARK-1, G0.3, ...).
'milestone' says which build (docs/PLAN.md M1, M2, M2b, M3, M4, M5) owns it. An empty milestone is deferred or the orchestrator's.

Reviewed 2026-10-16 (PLAN.md section 6): entries added by the review are ST-RESTRUCTURE, ST-JO-MATHS, ST-FACES, ST-GUIDES, ST-SPEC-CHECK, ST-UI-TARGET and the tests ST-T-GOLDEN-1, ST-T-RESTRUCTURE-1, ST-T-JO-1, ST-T-PLAN-5, ST-T-PLAN-6, ST-T-SCENE-2, ST-T-VERIFY-3, ST-T-VERIFY-4, ST-T-UI-11, ST-T-UI-12.
Feature statuses: planned, built, partial, deferred. Test statuses: planned, passing, failing, skipped.

kinds.pytest: a pytest test in ROOT/tests, run by tools/check.py
kinds.golden: a pytest test that replays a JSON golden made by REF's code read-only
kinds.vitest: a unit test of the web app in studio/src
kinds.playwright: an end-to-end test of the web app on the real server, with screenshots
kinds.opencv: a pytest test that needs numpy + cv2 (verify/)

features.name: OpenCV's dictionaries without OpenCV
features.description: The 21 predefined dictionaries from the checked JSON table; a marker as a grid, as merged black rectangles, as PNG and SVG. The table's sha256 is checked on load.

features.name: Single marker, grid board, ChArUco board
features.description: Counts, ids, extents, object points, chessboard corners, the ink and the frame OpenCV reports, exactly as cv2 5.0.0 makes them.

features.name: Auto size on a face with holes
features.description: The largest clear rectangle of an outline with holes and notches (proven branch and bound); the smart default; typed sizes clamped with a note; the ranked Layout list; the dictionary grows with the ids in use.

features.name: Cell multiple on a print grid (versioned, CELL_RULE 1)
features.description: Sizes on 0.5 mm steps (legacy, no 'cells' key) or every cell a whole number of the printer's line width. A tag without the key never changes.

features.name: Origin: the frame is always OpenCV's (versioned, ORIGIN_RULE 2)
features.description: Four quarter turns per layout; a rectangular board at 90 / 270 is OpenCV's board on its side; a node without 'origin_v' keeps the old rule. OpenCV's frame is derived from its conventions alone.

features.name: Modes and heights in Extrude's words
features.description: White + black, Black only, White only; each colour an extrude from an Offset, Height further; the parts (tile, pin, pocket, pattern, recess, trim) follow from where the slabs sit; the legacy height / thickness / above parameters map to the same geometry.

features.name: Corner mark
features.description: None / Cut / Triangle at OpenCV's corner 0, only where valid, never a marker's black cell; the old 'chamfer' checkbox reads as Cut.

features.name: Locating pins and their holes
features.description: A triangle or two round pins under a New-body tag with matching holes grown by the tolerance, clear of a cut corner, following OpenCV's origin.

features.name: Label: content, placement, the pixel font, the clearance rule (versioned, RULE 2)
features.description: One template, placed on the black or on the white, auto-sized in the 5-pixel font a 0.6 mm nozzle prints, every detection rule checked; a refused label still laid out as a preview with its violations in words; Build anyway; Auto position; every copy relabelled with its own id. A label without 'rule' is rule 1.

features.name: Trim excess (versioned, RULE 1)
features.description: The tag's outline plus a margin as the column the body keeps along x / y / both; the refusals (not a rectangle, a hole cut, too much volume lost, nothing measured); Cut anyway. REF: docs/design_aruco_trim.md, tests/test_aruco_trim*.py.

features.name: A tag's settings and numbers, all five generations
features.description: SPEC_VERSION 2, default_settings, normalise (old chamfer, frame, rotate_deg), Auto size = size 0, the edit model (what an edit changes: compute, rebuild, structural), the rebuild words.

features.name: Per-field messages
features.description: Every info line, warning and refusal of the tag form as an Issue(field, level, text): size, cells, layers, label, mark, pins, trim, origin. The same words the Fusion dialog shows.

features.name: Print presets and PrusaSlicer profiles
features.description: Built-in and named presets (printer profile, cell multiple, dictionary, mode, op, heights, quiet zone); a preset from a PrusaSlicer print profile (nozzle, line width, layer height) read from ini text; the file format bam_aruco_presets/1 kept.

features.name: Numbering planner
features.description: Every visible instance its own marker per dictionary family, boards contiguous, overrides exact, ids inside the dictionary or a named refusal, stable re-planning.

features.name: Printed ids never move
features.description: The id ledger (bam_aruco_ids_ledger/1): every copy ever numbered and every id ever printed; copies matched by stamp chain, place, then path; a printed id is never handed to another copy while the dictionary has unused ids.

features.name: One marker table
features.description: One row per tag copy named '<path>|<key>', natural order, duplicates flagged, the Status words.

features.name: Numbering over an assembly snapshot
features.description: plan_design, hidden copies, stamps, staleness and the auto-rebuild verdict over a plain AssemblySnapshot (tags, occurrences, overrides, ledger, state) that any adapter can fill (core/ids_design.py).

features.name: What a structural edit does, in the core
features.description: core/restructure.py: restructure_plan (which roles lose or gain a base feature or a combine between two node structures), the refusal words, what goes and who loses it; core/edits.py: the after-compute verdict. Pure; the adapter only executes it.

features.name: Joint Origin composition maths
features.description: core/geometry.py: jo_decompose(frame) -> (angle about the unflipped z, offsets along the final axes, flip) and jo_compose back, as Fusion composes a Joint Origin (REF aruco_tags._place_joint_origin). Any adapter that places a frame from three numbers uses it.

features.name: The target palette: box, disc, the ten faces
features.description: core/faces.py: REF's ten non-box gallery faces plus a box and a disc as loops in mm, tessellated the way Fusion strokes an edge. The Studio's stand-in for a clicked face; the autosize tests use the same list.

features.name: plan_tag: TagSpec in, TagPlan out
features.description: The port of aruco_feature.evaluate() as a pure function of settings, numbers and a Target (outline in mm): fit, Origin turn, mark, label (a strip grows the tile), pins, trim, slabs. Never raises. Replays REF's evaluate() goldens.

features.name: Layers: polygons with holes and a z range
features.description: tile, pocket, pattern, label cut / join, white strip, mark cut / triangle, pin, hole, recesses, trim keep column: each a colour, an op (add / cut / keep), a z range and 2D polygons in the pattern frame. One list feeds the 2D view, the 3D view, Fusion, build123d and the exports.

features.name: The OpenCV frame in the plan
features.description: TagPlan.frames.opencv: the detector's frame of the tag as built, in the pattern frame, plus the detector plane. What a Joint Origin, a URDF link or a viser frame is placed on.

features.name: The record a tag stores
features.description: spec, mark, label, trim and the rule versions as REF writes them (fusion.mark, fusion.label), the digests, 'OK unchanged writes nothing'. A REF record reads back into a TagSpec.

features.name: A copy's plan from the template's
features.description: Relabel by the copy's id and name; which cells flip colour between two ids (id_regions); the label slots. A copy's plan differs from the template's only there.

features.name: Triangles for the 3D view and STL
features.description: Every layer as a watertight triangle mesh (boxes, extruded polygons with holes).

features.name: Warnings per field in the plan
features.description: Every note evaluate() produced (autosize notes, the Origin note, the mark's 'instead', the label's violations, the trim's refusals) as an Issue on the field it belongs to.

features.name: Guides in the plan: quiet ring, clear zones, keep-outs, a refused label's preview
features.description: TagPlan.guides: the sticker, the quiet ring, the label's hard and preferred clear zones under its rule, the mark's and pins' keep-outs, a refused label's preview boxes and the target's loops, all in the pattern frame. What the 2D view draws and nothing prints; the app never derives them.

features.name: Every TagSpec field checked, by name
features.description: ARCHITECTURE 5.6: per field its type, valid range (REF's named constants), the Issue it gives and its level. A wrong type is a 422 / TypeError naming the key path; a wrong value is an Issue whose field is the key path (numbers.size, settings.label.cap_mm, ...). plan_tag never raises.

features.name: Many tags on one canvas
features.description: A Scene of SceneTags (name, TagSpec, pose in mm, locked); add, move, duplicate, delete.

features.name: The .arucostudio.json file (versioned)
features.description: arucostudio.scene/1: the scene as JSON without the cached plans; a migration per schema number; round-trip exact.

features.name: Renumber a scene
features.description: Unique ids per family across the scene through the real planner; typed overrides; the scene's own ledger so a printed tag keeps its id; a locked tag's ink never changes.

features.name: OpenCV reads every plan
features.description: A plan rendered from its own layers (label ink included) is read by cv2.aruco: every id, boards as boards.

features.name: The frame checked by PnP
features.description: The rendered plan warped into a pinhole camera 25 degrees off; solvePnP against the plan's object points equals TagPlan.frames.opencv within 0.1 mm / 0.1 deg.

features.name: SVG and PNG of a tag and of a scene
features.description: True-size SVG (viewBox in mm) and PNG (pHYs) from the layers; label ink and marks drawn as they print.

features.name: PDF print sheet
features.description: A true-size sheet on letter or A4, never scaled, ruler bars, '#id' in the border, the orientation triangle, the part name. Later: the 3D label's text (REF OI-PDF-LABEL).

features.name: STL per layer / per colour
features.description: One STL per tag part (tile, cells), face-down orientation for printing, from plan/mesh.

features.name: PrusaSlicer project with beds
features.description: The scene's tags packed on the printer's beds, tile on extruder 1 and cells on extruder 2, with the presets resolved from PrusaSlicer's vendor bundle (fixture).

features.name: The Studio API on 127.0.0.1:5360
features.description: FastAPI: health, dictionaries, plan, validate, candidates, scene open / save / renumber, exports, verify, presets, profiles; OpenAPI for the web app's types; serves studio/dist.

features.name: The Studio's own store
features.description: Presets (bam_aruco_presets/1), remembered options, the recent list, scenes and exports under ROOT/.data (ARUCO_STUDIO_HOME); PrusaSlicer's config directory read only. Never %USERPROFILE%/CADExporter.

features.name: 2D canvas like Figma
features.description: An SVG canvas: pan, zoom, select, drag with 0.5 mm snap, rulers; many tags, each on its own target; each drawn as target outline + layers + guides, every path tagged data-layer; the label's clear zones and a refused label in orange (data-state=refused).

features.name: The target editor
features.description: The Studio's stand-in for a clicked face: pick a box, a disc or one of the ten faces from /api/targets, or type width / height, a thickness (0 = no body) and holes; the canvas draws it; Auto size, pins, pockets and trim plan against it (prism volumes).

features.name: 3D view with a 2D / 3D toggle
features.description: three.js; the layers extruded between their z; heights, recesses, pins and the trim column visible; the OpenCV frame as a triad; the toggle keeps the view's centre like Google Maps.

features.name: The tag inspector with per-field messages
features.description: Layout, dictionary, id, size (Auto), cells, mode, op, Offset / Height per colour, Origin, corner mark, label, pins, trim; the Layout candidates; messages from /api/validate under each field.

features.name: The IDs table and Renumber
features.description: One row per scene tag; type an id to override; Renumber; click a row to select. Click again to zoom is M5 (ST-T-UI-12).

features.name: The print preset library
features.description: Cards with an SVG thumb, filters, Select / New / Duplicate / Edit / Delete / Import from a PrusaSlicer profile; a React port of REF's HTML library.

features.name: Export and Verify from the app
features.description: SVG / PNG / PDF / STL / 3MF buttons; Verify shows every id read and the PnP error per tag.

features.name: Open and save scenes
features.description: New, open, save, save as of .arucostudio.json; the recent list.

features.name: A Fusion face or profile as a Target
features.description: The face frame, the profile rectangle, the loops in mm, x_ref, has_body, z_sign, the body's box and volumes for trim, from REF's profile_rect / face_frame / keep_x / _trim_inputs.

features.name: TagPlan to Fusion bodies
features.description: Every layer a temporary body (boxes, prisms), join / cut / intersect per op, in parts order; tested against a fake adsk with a CSG stand-in. Not installed into Fusion in this run.

features.name: Records on the component
features.description: plan/record.py's dict plus the adapter's handles (tokens, body names, group); a REF record reads back into the same TagSpec and plan.

features.name: One Joint Origin per tag on OpenCV's frame
features.description: The composition maths (angle about the unflipped z, flip, offsets along the final axes) from TagPlan.frames.opencv; the read-back check; the one-per-tag rule.

features.name: Restructure plan
features.description: Which roles to delete and create between two node structures, the refusal words; the pure half, tested on the fake.

features.name: The migration map
features.description: docs/MIGRATION.md: every (F) responsibility and every Fusion quirk of REF's add-in mapped to the adapter; the switch-over steps for the live add-in, gated on the goldens.

features.name: Screws and holes against a ChArUco board
features.description: REF proposal_aruco_chamfer.md section 7: a head centred in a black square at most 0.35 of the square is safe; a bright head near an inner corner pulls it; never a screw in a white square; keep id 17 off other tags. Inventory gap 1.

features.name: Hamming distance among the ids in use; range-first dictionary choice
features.description: The minimum Hamming distance of the ids a scene uses; the largest bit size that still reads at the camera's range (markers.suggest). Inventory gap 6.

features.name: Forget retired ids
features.description: Let a retired id back into the pool on request. Inventory gap 7.

features.name: The sheet's full option set
features.description: id_text template, orient_corner, emboss_id, the chamfer cut line, the q >= 0.7 guard on the triangle; the 3D label's text printed on the sheet (REF OI-PDF-LABEL). Inventory gaps 2 and 3.

features.name: build123d adapter
features.description: A Face as a Target; each layer extruded and fused / cut; the assembly as an AssemblySnapshot for renumbering.

features.name: viser adapter
features.description: TagPlan.mesh per layer as viser meshes; the OpenCV frame as a frame handle; renumber from the scene graph.

features.name: Switch the live Fusion add-in to the new core
features.description: A later, Fusion-gated run: the add-in imports aruco_studio.core and plan; REF's edit gates re-run; every golden stays green.
